messages:
anna: heads up — VoltBank reported a p99 embeddings latency spike starting ~09:10 UTC. CSM escalated, they're seeing 800-1.2s vs usual ~150-200ms. Risk to SLA if this persists. Need a hot workaround + an owner for customer comms. who can take immediate ownership? https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-4721

jordan: on it. can someone grab the tail logs from pool-c-3? i'll try a quick KV-cache bypass in canary. @sam can you stand by for a runtime tweak? :rotating_light:

sam: standing by. if bypass helps we can push a config override first (no binary change):

```
echo '{"kv_cache_enabled": false}' > /etc/redwood/runtime_override.json && systemctl restart redwood-runtime
```

will test on canary instance i-0abc1234 first.

claire: CSM Michelle asked for an eta within 30m. i'll tell VoltBank we're investigating and may do a short restart. please keep me posted so i can update them. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Started canary restart on pool-c-3 (instance i-0abc1234). Stage: canary. Status: 1/3 restarted.

jordan: canary looks promising — p99 down to ~250ms on that node. starting full roll on pool-c-3 (gradual shift, 5m). @anna please confirm 5m traffic shift ok. :thumbsup:

anna: go for it. ping when full roll completes.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Full roll complete on pool-c-3. Health checks passed. Observability snapshot: p50=120ms, p95=180ms, p99=260ms.

sam: opened a short-lived PR to make the KV bypass guarded and auto-disable on normal tails — PR #4892 (description: "guarded kv cache override; triggers on p99>600ms for >3m"). assigning to jordan for quick review.

jordan: reviewing PR #4892 now, will merge if tests + canary pass. after merge let's add a paging alert: p99 > 600ms for >5m -> page oncall and notify platform-owner.

claire: :thumbsup: VoltBank CSM wants a brief postmortem and timeline. asked for follow-up by EOD. can we commit to that?

anna: yes — sam/jordan, please add RCA bullets and timeline to INC-4721 and mark next steps. i'll own the customer follow-up and send the status note once you add the details. thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.
